remarks: Enjoy gated community living in the heart of Stamford. This 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse in The Chesterfield. The main level includes a kitchen with an eat in kitchen, cathedral ceilings with a skylight, and a living room featuring a wood-burning fireplace and sliders to a deck-perfect for entertaining-plus a separate dining area and convenient half bath. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious bedroom with generous closets and storage, along with a full bath offering a soaking tub and double vanity. Additional perks include an in-unit washer/dryer, new HVAC, and flexible extra space ideal for guests or a home office. This gated community offers two pools and 24-hour security, with unbeatable access to shopping, transit, I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and downtown Stamford-schedule your private showing before it's gone.
